summary: A solid, gettable list and a very deep Blitz, but typing 'congo' goes straight to the small Republic of the Congo (#36) and costs a life, when almost every player means DR Congo (#4).
reasons: Nigeria, Egypt, Ethiopia, South Africa and Kenya are gimmes; Tanzania, Sudan, Uganda and Algeria take some thought; Morocco (#11) and Ghana (#13) are fair near misses.
The 'congo' trap costs a casual player a life early and makes DR Congo look missed; the rules say a name shared by 2-4 entries should offer a choice.
Blitz is deep: a casual player names 20 African countries in 90 seconds and every one scores.
fixes: Rename #36 'Congo' to 'Republic of the Congo' and make bare 'Congo' (and 'the Congo') a shared alias of #4 DR Congo and #36, so the game offers the choice.
Drop junk aliases: 'Ugandan nationalism', 'Ker Alur' (Uganda), 'Official language of Southern Sudan' (Sudan), 'North Kenya', 'Kenya-Africa' (Kenya), 'Belgian Ubanghi', 'CKN' (DR Congo).
